prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Resume to job matching
client: Hireloop
client_industry: HR tech
start: 2024-03
end: 2024-05
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- sentence-transformers
- Qdrant
- FastAPI
- Celery
implied_skills:
- semantic search
- background jobs
built: An embedding index of 210k resumes that recruiters query with a job description,
  re-embedded by Celery workers when profiles change.
metrics:
- recall@10 from 0.72 to 0.86 on 300 labelled searches

The review is from: Hireloop
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on the end result; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "semantic search", "background jobs".
text: Noor did a great job on our resume-to-job matching project. He delivered an embedding-based system for our 210k-resume database that gave recruiters much better matches from a job description, and our recall@10 improved from 0.72 to 0.86 on 300 labelled searches. The solution was reliable and handled profile updates cleanly. Would work with him again.
